content:
Amazon Prime Day is here again, and it provides an unmissable opportunity to upgrade your home with Roborock’s smartest vacuums at the lowest prices ever offered.

The offers run from June 23 to June 26, and apply to a wide range of the company’s products – from the entry-level Q7 M5 Plus all the way up to the flagship Saros 20.

Roborock is of course best known for its robot cleaners, and the company has a model for every budget and size of home.

Even the company’s entry-level model, intended for smaller homes, still has an impressive feature set. Offering around eight weeks of hands-free cleaning, the system efficiently collects pet hair, dirt and debris without the need for constant emptying. Features include PreciSense LiDAR navigation to precisely map your home and ensure optimised cleaning paths, and the company’s Dual Anti-Tangle design to resist pet hairs getting wrapped around the roller, even with long hair breeds. You get full control and access to automated cleaning schedules through the Roborock app. Save $200.

This model takes things up a notch with a high-temperature self-cleaning routine and warm air drying to refresh the mops after each use. The smart mopping system adjusts the water flow to boost cleaning for tough stains while using less water for routine mopping. Smart obstacle detection allows the robot to avoid shoes, toys, and furniture legs while using its low clearance to glide smoothly under beds and sofas. The AI-powered Roborock SmartPlan 2.0 adjusts settings intelligently based on your home layout, floor types, and cleaning history. Save $250.

The Qrevo Curv 2 Flow adds SpiraFlow real-time self-cleaning mop capabilities. Instead of just cleaning the mops between uses, a built-in scraper and eight precise hydration points use clean water to refresh the mop in real time as it cleans. This enables it to remove dust, dirt, grime, and sticky messes without streaks. The edge-adaptive roller reaches corners, chair legs, and edges with ease for 100% sweeping using 15N pressure for a deep and consistent clean. Save $300.

The Qrevo Edge 2 offers 25,000 PA HyperSuction paired with an upgraded mopping system and an ultra-slim design to conquer very low spaces like modern beds and sofas. At just 3.14 inches high, it’s equipped with a RetractSense Navigation system which accurately measures overhead clearance to retract the laser module when entering low spaces. The 100-degree vision module takes over to maintain accurate positioning in confined areas, ensuring reliable navigation anywhere. The model includes Roborock’s exclusive FlexiArm Arc side brush to extend its reach to clean walls, corners, and toe kick areas down to 0.98 inches. Reactive AI obstacle recognition recognises and avoids over 280 types of objects. Coupled to intelligent dirt detection, the robot automatically adjusts cleaning cycles and triggers rewashes for heavily soiled areas. Save $435.

The flagship Saros10R is designed for the largest and most intricate of homes. It combines a 3.14 inch ultra-thin design with Roborock’s advanced StarSight Autonomous System 2.0 to completely eliminate the need for a raised laser unit. The innovative VertiBeam lateral obstacle avoidance system navigates cables and irregular furniture shapes with ease, even cleaning along cords without manual intervention. Its industry-first AdaptiLift chassis can lift the robot to enable it to navigate steps and other obstacles up to 4 cm high, including thresholds and U-shaped furniture legs. It automatically detects the switch from hardwood flooring to carpets and lifts the dual spinning mops automatically to prevent wetting long pile carpets. The 10-in-1 multifunctional dock includes features like auto-mop removal, auto tank refilling, auto detergent dispensing, and full self-cleaning. The built-in Hello Rocky voice assistant allows you to begin cleaning tasks and access other features with simple voice commands. Finally, the built-in RGB camera lets you stay connected to your pets while you’re away through two-way video calls. The robot can even locate your pets in your home and automatically navigate to them. Save $715.

Cordless wet-dry vacuums

If you’re looking to take full control of the cleaning yourself, Roborock’s Prime Day deals include both entry-level and flagship cordless wet-dry vacuum models.

Intended to simplify the cleaning routine for smaller homes, the F25 GT is a vacuum mop combo intended for hard floors, including tile, vinyl, hardwood, laminate, and linoleum. With 20,000 PA suction, this cordless cleaner easily lifts pet hair, spilled cereal, kitchen grease, and bathroom grime while cleaning up mud near a balcony with no need to switch tools. It’s an ultralight model weighing just 8.8 pounds, and offering 180-degree lie-flat reach with 70-degree swivel steering to fit under couches, beds and cabinets. It’s ideal for compact apartments and tight corners. Despite its affordability, the F25 GT still includes self-cleaning with high temperature washing and air drying to keep the roller brush clean and odor-free. Save $120.

The F25 Ultra is Roborock’s flagship cordless wet-dry vacuum. An industry first, the Ultra combines two powerful high-temperature cleaning modes: hot water and steam. This enables the cleaner to tackle dried-on messes and the most stubborn of stains with a 356F steam spray across the full cleaning width without the use of any harsh chemicals. It combines wet and dry cleaning in a single stroke, with a massive 33N of downward cleaning pressure, 22,000 Pa suction power and <1mm true edge-to-edge cleaning. It offers 99.99% bacteria removal with zero damage to wooden floors, tested with 18,000 strokes representing five years of cumulative use with no swelling, warping or cracking. The Ultra looks after itself as well as your floors: built-in non-hazardous descalers prevent scale formation and protect the pipes from clogging for up to three years. Save $325.

All of Roborock’s Prime Day deals can be accessed here, but don’t delay as these heavily-discounted prices won’t last long!
